headline: Vote on a $20,000 storefront loan for Portland House of Music at 25 Temple Street, and on two Brownfields grant amendments.
summary: Requests from Roux Institute and Portland Housing Authority to amend Brownfields grants are also up for a vote. The agenda includes the November treasurer's report and a verbal staff update.
items: Review and vote on Brownfields grant amendment request from Roux Institute
Review and vote on Brownfields grant amendment request from Portland Housing Authority
Review and vote on $20,000 interest-free storefront loan from Garden Concerts, LLC (Portland House of Music), 25 Temple Street; board may go into executive session
Treasurer's report for November 2026, including a confidential delinquency report; board may go into executive session on listed loans
Other items raised by board directors

To submit written public comment on an agenda item,

AGENDA 
 
1. President's comments  
     
      
2. Review and accept Meeting Minutes

public comment during its meetings, including the authority to limit the duration of comments. Since the 
Commission makes recommendations to the City Council, public comment is available at that level.
